subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should an unpinned `systemEvent` plus concrete announce delivery remain invalid unless the caller explicitly creates an isolated agent turn, or should cron infer and persist that conversion?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the choice defines the public meaning of `systemEvent`, default session targeting, and delivery behavior; it cannot be resolved safely from tests alone.

options.title: Keep the explicit agent-turn contract
options.body: Retain the rejection and make the error or CLI guidance point callers to an explicit isolated `agentTurn` job.

options.title: Adopt documented inference
options.body: Accept the conversion only after documenting it as a stable cron contract and proving the resulting scheduled announcement in a real channel setup.

recommendation.title: Keep the explicit agent-turn contract
recommendation.body: Retain the rejection and make the error or CLI guidance point callers to an explicit isolated `agentTurn` job.

likelyOwner.reason: A cron-area history owner should make this public-contract decision; repository-history inspection was unavailable in this read-only environment.
